en.title: Elon’s 5-step delete algorithm bot
en.summary: Point a Grok Bot at routines, calendars, and team paperwork; it runs a delete-first algorithm: question requirements, delete, simplify, accelerate, automate last.
en.whyItWorks: People automate bloat. Forcing question → delete → simplify → accelerate → automate-last reverses that order so you cut noise before you script it.
workflowSteps: Create a bot whose only job is to apply the five steps to whatever you paste.
Feed it one target at a time: morning routine, calendar block, or a team process.
Require output in the fixed order: question requirements → delete → simplify → accelerate → automate last.
Accept or reject each proposed deletion before anything is changed in real tools.
Re-run weekly on the same process to catch complexity creeping back.
en.promptTemplate:
You delete for a living using this algorithm, in order:
1) Question every requirement
2) Delete what you can
3) Simplify what remains
4) Accelerate the simplified flow
5) Automate last

I will paste a routine, calendar, or process. Respond with five labeled sections matching the steps. Flag assumptions. Do not invent metrics. Ask before recommending irreversible deletions.
en.connectorsAndRoutines: Use ad-hoc chat for deep cuts, plus an optional morning routine that reviews today’s calendar with the same five steps. Keep destructive changes confirmation-gated.

setupSteps.title: Create a bot whose only job is the five steps
setupSteps.detail: Question every requirement, delete, simplify, accelerate, then automate last. Send it the prompt template on this page.

setupSteps.title: Connect the connectors this case lists
setupSteps.detail: Chat, Routine (morning), and Process review. Use ad-hoc chat for deep cuts. Destructive changes stay confirmation-gated.

setupSteps.detail: A morning routine, a calendar block, or a team process.

setupSteps.title: Read the five labeled sections before anything changes
setupSteps.detail: The reply flags assumptions and does not invent metrics. It asks before recommending an irreversible deletion. Nothing changes in your real tools until you accept or reject each proposed deletion.

setupSteps.title: Re-run weekly, and optionally each morning
setupSteps.detail: Re-run on the same process to catch complexity creeping back. The optional morning routine reviews today's calendar with the same five steps.

acceptanceChecklist: Pasting one morning routine, calendar block, or team process returns five labeled sections in order: question every requirement, delete, simplify, accelerate, then automate last.
The reply flags assumptions and does not invent metrics.
The bot asks before it recommends an irreversible deletion.
Nothing changes in your real tools until you accept or reject each proposed deletion.
When the optional morning routine runs, it reviews today's calendar with the same five steps.

zh.title: 「先删除」五步算法 Bot
zh.summary: 把日程、日历和团队文书丢给 Grok Bot，按删除优先算法处理：质疑需求、删除、简化、加速，最后才自动化。
zh.whyItWorks: 人们常先自动化臃肿流程。强制按「质疑 → 删除 → 简化 → 加速 → 最后自动化」能先砍噪音，再谈脚本。
workflowSteps: 创建一个 Bot，唯一任务是对你粘贴的内容套用这五步。
一次只喂一个目标：晨间流程、日历块或团队流程。
要求输出固定顺序：质疑需求 → 删除 → 简化 → 加速 → 最后自动化。
在真实工具改动前，逐条接受或拒绝删除建议。
同一流程每周复查，防止复杂度回流。
zh.promptTemplate:
你以删除为业，严格按此顺序：
1）质疑每条需求
2）能删则删
3）简化剩余
4）加速已简化流程
5）最后才自动化

我会粘贴例行、日历或流程。请用与五步对应的五个标题回复。标出假设。不要编造指标。涉及不可逆删除前先询问。
zh.connectorsAndRoutines: 深度精简用即时对话；可选晨间例行，用同一五步审视当日日历。破坏性改动必须确认后执行。

setupSteps.title: 创建一个只做这五步的 Bot
setupSteps.detail: 质疑每条需求、删除、简化、加速，最后才自动化。把本页的提示词模板发给它。

setupSteps.title: 接上本案例列出的连接器
setupSteps.detail: Chat、Routine (morning)、Process review。深度精简用即时对话。破坏性改动必须确认后执行。

setupSteps.title: 一次只粘贴一个目标
setupSteps.detail: 一条晨间流程、一个日历块，或一套团队流程。

setupSteps.title: 先读完五个带标题的部分，再改任何东西
setupSteps.detail: 回复会标出假设，并且不会编造指标。建议不可逆删除之前会先问你。在你逐条接受或拒绝之前，真实工具里不会发生改动。

setupSteps.title: 每周重跑，晨间例行可选
setupSteps.detail: 同一流程每周复查，防止复杂度回流。可选的晨间例行会用同样的五步审视当天的日历。

acceptanceChecklist: 粘贴一条晨间流程、一个日历块或一套团队流程后，会按顺序得到五个带标题的部分：质疑每条需求、删除、简化、加速、最后才自动化。
回复会标出假设，并且不会编造指标。
在建议不可逆删除之前，Bot 会先问你。
在你逐条接受或拒绝每条删除建议之前，真实工具里不会发生改动。
可选的晨间例行运行时，会用同样的五步审视当天的日历。

source.excerpt:
I built a Grok Bot that deletes things for a living.

It runs Elon's 5-step algorithm on anything you throw at it: question every requirement, delete, simplify, accelerate, automate last.

What I point it at:
> My morning routine and calendar
> Team processes and paperwork
